_about: TamTam clay renders — the list of art keys the storefront may reference (media.art_key, <Art name>). Each key renders a 'hero' view (three-quarter); keys with extra views also produce '<key>@front' / '<key>@back'. Dimensions are the real hardware in millimetres (width × height × depth as the device normally stands) so proportions stay accurate. No brand logos are modelled; renders are stylised illustrations, not product photographs.

games._about: Physical game cases. One case model per platform (Switch: red case 105×170×11; PS5: blue-topped clear case 135×171×14; Xbox: green case 135×171×14). The cover is generated typography on an abstract pattern in the platform colour — no real cover art, characters or publisher logos. Art key = 'game-<slug>'.
